spans.s: लुम्बिका [lumbikā], A kind of musical instrument.
लुम्बिनी [lumbinī], N. of a grove and the birthplace of Gautama Buddha; सान्तःपुरना देवी कदाचिदथ लुम्बिनीं (जगाम) Bu.
लुम्ब् [lumb], 1 P., 1 U. (लुम्बति, लुम्बयति ते) To torment, harass.
लूमम् [lūmam], [लू-मक्] A tail. -Comp. -विषः 'having poison in the tail', an animal that stings with its tail.
